title: The slow loop: every action carries the digest
subtitle: A tool-use loop whose mandatory side output is the other agent's grounding

messages.label: observe(): indexed elements + page text + screenshot
drain fast_to_slow: notes join the observation as [PHONE CHANNEL]
messages + tools (tool_choice: any — a tool is mandatory)
one or more tool calls, each with state_summary
state_summary -> digest (written before the tool runs)
click / type / select / navigate by [n] index
tool results — only the last carries the new observation
repeat, up to 60 steps; screenshots trimmed to the newest 2

messages.text: ask_user / tell_user are ordinary tools here: they enqueue a message and return at once. The loop never blocks on the conversation.
